audit.why: Swain bullies a mana-starved early Ryze, first item evens, Ryze outscales at two items — 57.8% WR and content chart agree.
Spikes present: early Swain window, 6 dive, Tear/Archangel's even, late Ryze outscale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits and missed the decisive mechanic — Rune Prison only ROOTS through Spell Flux, otherwise it slows; full phases[0] and [3] read Skill vs content Swain.
audit.why: Ryze W is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s (root requires Flux), E 3.5s, Q 5s reset-driven — the E-W-Q order is the tell to respect.
audit.corrected: Flux-gated root and numbers added; chart rows aligned.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — Ryze is mana-starved and his Q does little, while your Q out-pokes him off the wave. Push and deny.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours: your combo out-damages his mana-limited kit before items. Bank the CS lead — his spike is coming.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Check it before every step-up. - E Nevermove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and only ROOTS if Spell Flux is on you first — respect the E-W-Q chain and check it before every step-up. - His E is 3.5s and Q 5s: the spam never stops, but the root does. - E Nevermove is the lifeline.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Ryze has no dash at all — after Nevermove connects, drop W on his retreat path so the slow holds him in your Q range and banks another soul.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: At half HP a Flux-marked Rune Prison becomes a full root into the E-Q chain — his kill window opens exactly where yours closes.
